review.base: Ordinance names no base district. It rezoned 'A' Apartment (8 tracts) and PD-CC (Ord. 828, 9.4274 ac) to this PD, which has its own full use list and standards (Table A). Set to null so the old A standards do not show.
review.ordinances: 074-171 (1974) and 076-267 (1976) are pre-PD apartment variances under the old A district (3-story apartments; The Pier unit sizes and 260 units). Their standards are ignored.
review.acres: Exhibit A totals 99.176 ac (54.017 + 45.159); pds.json says 97.7. Caption says A-zoned part is 87.7486 ac, Sec. 2 says 89.7486 ac.
review.uses: Mapped by judgment: Townhouse to single-family attached; Condominium to multifamily; retail list (p.11-13, incl. department and grocery stores, no size limit) to all three retail size classes; barber, tailor, shoe repair, cleaning pick-up, fix-it, film developing to Personal services; professional offices, title companies, travel services to Office; health club to indoor recreation; Hotel to both full and limited service; public safety facilities to public police/fire. Retail is allowed only as part of a mixed use with residential, except portable kiosks (25-500 sq ft) anywhere; free-standing retail is prohibited (p.14-15).
review.dimensions: Sec. 14 (p.22) lets P&Z and Council waive any standard in Secs. 5-13 with a development plan, but not to add a use. Source text reads 'does increase the allowable intensity' (likely missing 'not'). The OCR text drops these last lines; see the PDF.
review.buildTo: Street types A-E are shown on the Concept Plan (Exhibit C). Measured from the closest right-of-way line.
review.facadeAtBuildToMin: Derived: text says not more than 30% (50% in Subarea 1) of any street frontage may vary from the build-to line.
review.heightMax: 60 ft applies to the part of a building within 100 ft of land zoned single family or apartment or used for residential. All heights subject to FAA approval. Turrets, spires, towers may be up to 15 ft above the max (p.17).
review.unitSizeMin: Table row is 'Minimum area per Residential dwelling unit'; read as unit floor area, not lot area per unit. The same cell block also lists 'Office uses 500,000 sq. ft.', which looks like part of the max nonresidential floor area row.
review.lotCoverageMax: Porches and arcades fronting a street are excluded; above-grade parking structures are included (p.16).

notes: Max nonresidential floor area: office 500,000 sq ft; retail, restaurant, and personal service 500,000 sq ft. Must follow the Concept Plan (Exhibit C), street standards (Exhibit D), street lighting and furnishings (Exhibit E), and sustainability program (Exhibit F). A development plan is required before permits. Block length 200-750 ft. At least 80% masonry on walls facing streets. Public open space: 2 ac per 1,000 residents up to 2,250 residents, then 1.5 ac per 1,000.
